title: My Summer Car
provenance: Reported by t0nn-1 (highball-db#225, 2026-09-26), Apple M4, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.33, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, DXMT (the environment's mode), rated 5 of 5 after 6 minutes, with the DLL overrides version=n,b;winmm=n,b;winhttp=n,b set. nik-19201 (highball-db#245, 2026-09-28), Apple M1, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.39, engine x64-crossover26.3-r12, D3DMetal, rated 4 after 32 minutes, frame cap 60, DLL override winhttp=n,b, recipes steam and vcrun2022. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXMT on an M4 with the steam, corefonts and vcrun2022 recipes on the Wine 10 engine r5, and playable on D3DMetal on an M1 with the Wine 11 engine r12. The MSCLoader mod loader needs winhttp=n,b in the DLL overrides field, not the environment variables box, and both reporters run it that way (highball#203 was that mix-up, and the loader works for them since). The M1 report has some stutter where there are many light sources, which the reporter puts down to the game being CPU-bound. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here.
